skills.description: Behzad Mohit's Thermoinfocomplexity — an executable toolkit for understanding the unified theory that integrates thermodynamics, information theory, and complexity science to explain the origin of life. Related skills: the-grand-design (physics and existence), the-pleasure-of-finding-things-out (scientific discovery), homo-deus (future of humanity), a-mind-for-numbers (scientific thinking).
